summary: The Beast Titan throws a perfect game of stones and destroys the corps on the open ground. Erwin sees the annihilation and still has one charge left to order.

segments.ja: 壁の上の獣が、砕いた岩を平地へ投げます。投げる軌道は、訓練の砲より正確です。正確な石が、馬と人を同時に砕きます。砕く光景を、エルヴィンは先頭近くで見ます。見る光景は、予測していた全滅です。全滅を、彼は驚く顔では受けません。受けない理由は、名簿の上で昨夜すでに死んでいた、です。死んでいた予測が、今日、音になります。
segments.en: The Beast on the wall throws crushed rock onto the flat ground. The arc of the throwing is more exact than a training gun. The exact stones crush horses and people at the same time. Erwin sees the scene of crushing from near the front. The scene he sees is the annihilation he had predicted. He does not receive the annihilation with a surprised face. The reason he does not receive it is that on the roster they had already died last night. The prediction that had died becomes a sound today.

segments.ja: 獣の投擲は、外れがほとんどありません。ほとんどない投球を、完全試合と呼べます。呼べる残酷さは、遊びの言葉を戦場に置くことです。置く言葉の中で、新兵が一人ずつ消えます。消える速度を、生存者は数えられません。数えられないことが、試合の完成です。完成した側に、意思があります。意思の主は、まだジークという名では呼ばれていません。呼ばれていなくても、投げる手は人間の戦術です。
segments.en: The Beast's throwing has almost no misses. A pitching with almost none can be called a perfect game. The cruelty that can be called that is putting a word of play onto a battlefield. Inside the word that is put, recruits vanish one by one. Survivors cannot count the speed of vanishing. Not being able to count is the completion of the game. On the side that completed it, there is a will. The master of the will is not yet called by the name Zeke. Even not called, the hand that throws is a human tactic.

segments.ja: 平地の右翼は、数投で形を失います。失う形は、壁の外の希望そのものです。希望を、エルヴィンは維持する言葉を持ちません。持たないまま、彼は生き残った馬を集めます。集める目的は、逃げではなく、獣の注意を買う突撃です。買う突撃を、彼はまだ命令していません。していない理由は、街の側の超大型が同時に燃えている、です。燃えている二つの全滅を、一人の団長が見ます。
segments.en: The right wing on the flat ground loses its shape in a few throws. The shape it loses is hope outside the wall itself. Erwin has no words to maintain the hope. Without having them, he gathers the horses that survived. The purpose of gathering is not flight. It is a charge that buys the Beast's attention. He has not yet ordered the charge he would buy. The reason he has not is that the Colossal on the town's side is burning at the same time. One Commander sees the two annihilations that are burning.

segments.en: Erwin has a conception of sending Levi to the Beast's feet. The conception he has is that he himself draws attention at the front of a charge, and Levi enters from the sky. The stones of the perfect game hurry the conception of entering. At the scene that hurries it, he has not yet told the soldiers the meaning of death. The silence of not having told it is before the next episode of the hero. Before that, he looks at one recruit's eyes. He cannot put a false hope in the eyes he looks at. The honesty that cannot be put is the Commander's last preparation.

It is unclear whether the report that he is there reaches Erwin. While it is unclear, the two battlefields look like the failure of one operation. The Commander still supports the failure that is visible with the condition of the basement. The reason he supports it is that if they withdraw here, ignorance wins. Rather than the ignorance that wins, he chooses the page beyond the annihilation. Choosing is the reason he does not break even seeing the perfect game.
